info.title: ArticleNotes API
info.summary: Personal notes and highlights on FreshRSS articles and web pages.
info.description:
The `v1` API of the FreshRSS ArticleNotes extension. Every path lives below
`<FreshRSS base URL>/api/misc.php/ArticleNotes/`. A user only ever reads or writes their own annotations.

**Authentication.** HTTP Basic with the user name and the FreshRSS *API password* (Configuration → Profile → "API
password", never the web login password), or a Google Reader `GoogleLogin auth=<user>/<token>` token from FreshRSS's
ClientLogin. The API password also grants Google Reader and Fever API access to the account: use HTTPS outside
localhost. Only `GET v1/openapi.json` needs no credentials.

**Concurrency.** Single notes and highlights carry an `ETag` response header. Send it back as `If-Match` on `PUT`,
`PATCH` and `DELETE`; a changed object answers `412 precondition_failed`, and the client refetches.

**Paging and sync.** List endpoints return a `continuation` (null on the last page) and the `server_time` to use as the
next `since`. New keys may appear in objects in later versions; ignore what you do not know.

**CORS.** Browser pages are only allowed when an administrator lists their origin; see the `Origin` handling in the
README ("Building a client"). Allowed origins get `Access-Control-*` headers and `OPTIONS` preflights answer `204`.

servers.description: Your FreshRSS instance (the served description names its actual URL).

get.summary: Check the credentials and get the extension version.

200.description: The authenticated user and the API version.
The OpenAPI 3.1 document, naming this instance in `servers`.

get.summary: List article and page notes, oldest change first (sync).
get.description: Ordered by `updated_at`, then `id`. With `since`, deleted notes (tombstones) are included unless `include_deleted=0`.

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: `1` to include tombstones, `0` to leave them out. Default: `1` when `since` is given, else `0`.

get.summary: The live note of an article.

put.summary: Create or replace the note of an article.
put.description: Empty text (after trimming) deletes the note and answers `204`. Send `If-Match` to avoid overwriting a newer version; `If-Match` on an article without note fails with `412`.

delete.summary: Delete the note of an article (keeps a tombstone).

get.summary: What does the user have on this web page?
get.description: Finds the FreshRSS articles behind a URL (matching the normalized URL) with their notes and highlights, plus the page note and page highlights of the URL itself.

get.summary: The note of a web page that is no FreshRSS article.

put.summary: Create or replace a page note.
put.description: Empty text deletes it (`204`). A URL that is a FreshRSS article answers `409 url_is_article`; use `PUT v1/notes/{entry_id}`.

get.summary: List highlights, by target or changed since a time.
get.description: With `entry_id` or `url`, the live highlights of that article or page in document order. Otherwise a sync page ordered by `updated_at`, then `id`, with tombstones when `since` is given (as for `v1/notes`).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Page URL (an article with that URL, else a page). Not together with `entry_id`.

200.description: Highlights (`continuation` and `server_time` only in sync mode).

post.description: The same `uuid` on the same target returns the existing highlight with `200`; on another target, or of a deleted highlight, `409 uuid_conflict`. Give `entry_id` or `url`.

patch.summary: Change the note and/or color of a highlight.
patch.description: The selector is immutable (`400 selector_immutable`): delete the highlight and create a new one.

get.summary: Notes and highlights as W3C Web Annotation JSON-LD.
get.description:
Live notes and highlights (the W3C model has no tombstones) as an `AnnotationCollection`. With `entry_id` or `url`:
everything on that article or page. Otherwise the annotations changed at or after `since`, merged in
`updated_at` order and paged with `limit` / `continuation`. `continuation` and `server_time` are extra members.

get.summary: Every article and page the user annotated.
get.description:
One entry per target with a live note or highlight, independent of the "Annotated" label, most recently annotated
first (`last_annotated_at` descending, then article id and page key descending). With `since`, only targets with an
annotation created, edited or deleted at or after it, and a `removed` list (first page only) of targets that no
longer have any live annotation.

parameters.name: feed_id
parameters.description: Only articles of this FreshRSS feed.

removed.description: Present when `since` is given (first page only).

basicAuth.description: FreshRSS user name and API password (not the web password).

googleLogin.name: Authorization
googleLogin.description: `GoogleLogin auth=<user>/<token>`, the token returned by FreshRSS's Google Reader ClientLogin.

Url.name: url
Url.description: An http or https page URL (normalized by the server: fragment, tracking parameters, `www.` and scheme are ignored).

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The `ETag` last seen. Mismatch answers `412`; `*` matches any existing object.

Since.name: since
Since.description: Unix time; only what changed at or after it.

Continuation.name: continuation
Continuation.description: The `continuation` of the previous page (it keeps that request's filters).

ETag.description: Version of the object, to send back as `If-Match`.

NotFound.description: Unknown path, article, note or highlight (`not_found`).

PreconditionFailed.description: `precondition_failed`: the object changed since the `If-Match` version. Refetch it.

Continuation.description: Pass as `continuation` to get the next page; null on the last page.

ServerTime.description: Server Unix time when the page was read; use it as the next `since`.

NoteText.description: Plain text, stored as entered. Always escape it when you display it.

ArticleSnapshot.description: The article as it was when the annotation was last saved; it outlives the article.

exists.description: Whether FreshRSS still has the article.

Selector.description: Modeled on the W3C Web Annotation selectors. The server validates and stores it; clients anchor it.

position.description: Character offsets into the container's text content; only meaningful within the same `source`.

uuid.description: A client-generated UUID v4; makes creation idempotent.

entry_id.description: A FreshRSS article. Give this or `url`.

url.description: An article with that URL, else a page.

source.description: `freshrss`: selected in FreshRSS's rendering of the article; `page`: on the original web page.

index_complete.description: False while articles remain to be indexed; a later lookup may find more.

note.description: The article note or page note, or null.

last_annotated_at.description: Latest `updated_at` of the target's live note and highlights.

total.description: Omitted when the result is paged.
